summary: Independent design review APPROVE under the current Policy 2.6.0 binding. The actual event sequence includes scoped subject sync, policy_changed escalation and resolution, reclassification and refreeze; the route remains REVIEW/V1. All six actions remain deny_automatic, only push/merge use standing_or_action, and the external-action review rule retains its original priority and conditions. The frozen scope and owner-authorized delivery boundary remain consistent. Implementation review, native verification, action conditions and required CI remain separate.
